Package edu.harvard.hul.ois.fits

Class FitsOutput

  • java.lang.Object
    • edu.harvard.hul.ois.fits.FitsOutput
  • public class FitsOutput
extends Object
    This class acts as a wrapper around the fitsXML JDOM Document and provides convenience methods for converting the FITS XML format to standard technical metadata schemas, accessing identification, file info, and metadata elements
    Author:
    spencer
